notablePrerequisites:
Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
Any opponent chosen with Stuffy Doll.
description:
Activate Tree of Perdition targeting the opponent chosen with Stuffy Doll, exchanging their life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Star of Extinction for {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to all creatures and planeswalkers.
Stuffy Doll triggers, dealing 20 damage to that same opponent.
